cd /workspace && cat > tmp/gen_plan.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, random, sys
def gen(seed, nflows=22, nnodes=8, cap_hi=3, same_path=False):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    nodes = ['n%d'%i for i in range(nnodes)]
    caps = {n: rng.randint(0,cap_hi) for n in nodes}
    flows=[]; ids=[]
    for i in range(nflows):
        fid='f%02d'%i; ids.append(fid)
        L=10
        if same_path:
            path=rng.sample(nodes,3)
        else:
            path=rng.sample(nodes, rng.randint(2,4))
        kinds=['K']*L; kinds[0]='Q'; kinds[1]='T'
        kinds[2]='D'
        flows.append(dict(id=fid,path=path,template=bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(L)).hex(),kinds=''.join(kinds)))
    warmup=rng.choice([0,5])
    offers={}
    for f in flows:
        runs=[dict(header=f['template'],count=rng.randint(1,1000)) for _ in range(rng.randint(0,3))]
        offers[f['id']]=runs
    pinned=rng.sample(ids,rng.randint(0,2))
    return dict(mode='plan',capacities=caps,flows=flows,warmup=warmup,pinned=pinned,offers=offers)
seed=int(sys.argv[1]); same = len(sys.argv)>2 and sys.argv[2]=='same'
print(json.dumps(gen(seed, same_path=same)))
PYEOF
for s in 1 2 3 4 5; do python3 tmp/gen_plan.py $s > tmp/p.json; /usr/bin/time -f "%e s" python3 -I -B submission/main.py < tmp/p.json > tmp/p.out 2>tmp/t.txt; cat tmp/t.txt; head -c 200 tmp/p.out; echo; done
